name: Himuon Integration for Klaviyo and Gravity Forms
author: Reagan Mahinay

sections.description:
A robust Gravity Forms add-on that seamlessly integrates with Klaviyo, converting form submissions into Klaviyo profiles and automatically subscribing them to selected lists.

This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with Klaviyo or Rocketgenius.

This plugin requires the Gravity Forms plugin (commercial plugin, not hosted on WordPress.org).

Features

  • Unlimited Feeds: Create unlimited feeds for each Gravity Form.
  • List ID Validation: Validate Klaviyo List IDs with a single click to ensure they are correct before syncing.
  • Field Mapping: Map Gravity Forms fields to Klaviyo profile attributes, including email, first name, and last name.
  • Submission Status Notifications: View per-feed notifications indicating whether each submission synced successfully or failed.
  • Manual Re-Sync: Re-sync individual entries to Klaviyo for each configured feed.

External Services

This plugin integrates with Klaviyo, a third-party email marketing service.

All data mapping and transmission behavior is configured by the site administrator.

The plugin sends data to Klaviyo only when:
– An administrator has configured Klaviyo API credentials
– A user submits a Gravity Forms form configured by the site administrator

Data sent may include:
– Email address
– Form field values mapped by the administrator

This data is sent to Klaviyo to create or update subscriber profiles and list memberships.

Klaviyo is provided by Klaviyo, Inc.
Terms of Service: https://www.klaviyo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/privacy

This plugin does not track users, does not send data automatically, and does not transmit data in the background.

Trademarks

Klaviyo® is a registered trademark of Klaviyo, Inc.
Gravity Forms® is a registered trademark of Rocketgenius, Inc.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Klaviyo or Rocketgenius.
sections.faq:
Is it translation-ready?

Yes. You can use tools like Loco Translate to add your own translations.
